title: AGY PPT slide job
description: A single-slide image job that AGY hands to codex_image_adapter.py. This is the adapter-facing contract; the richer upstream prompts/slide_XX.json job file (produced by prepare_slide_prompts.py) remains the source of the full prompt and input images.

output_path.description: Workspace-relative path for the final slide image, e.g. origin_image/slide_03.png.
